pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

2. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.

3. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

4. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

5. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

6. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.

7. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. happiness
   D. run

8. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.

9. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.

10. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

11. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

12. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

2. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

3. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

4. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

5. D — Where is the library?

6. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

7. D — run

8. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

9. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

10. D — A person, place, thing, or idea

11. B — One main idea with supporting sentences

12. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Connected text and fluency; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language Activities at home; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Comprehension; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Handwriting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
